name: kubeconfig user credential fields
description: Credential-bearing fields of a kubeconfig file's users entries (token, username and password, client-key-data, and path or exec references), distinct from the cluster and context metadata beside them.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. A structured file, not a fixed-format token. The base64 or PEM material inside client-key-data is the existing generic:private-key family (#54); encoded representation questions are #94 and mixed layouts are #99.
